newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar softens to 477.25/478.25 vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar softens to 477.25/478.25 vs dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar softened to 477.25/478.25 after corporate clients made heavy demands for dollars in a busy session, traders said,.
The unit closed Friday at 476.75/477.75 per dollar.
"It was corporate demand that softened the bolivar," said one trader. The Central Bank "was watching the market all day, but only came in the afternoon, when it injected a wave of dollars," he added.
Traders said the fall in the bolivar's price was to be expected. "The bolivar's been rather cheap these past few days," said one.
